title: Add column sorting to JobsPage table
description:
JobsPage table headers are not clickable/sortable. Add client-side column sorting.

**Implementation:**
- Make column headers clickable with sort direction indicator (arrow up/down)
- Support sorting by: Topic (alpha), State (status order), Updated (time), Duration (numeric)
- Toggle asc/desc on repeat click, default desc for time columns
- Store sort state in component (no URL persistence needed)
- Use `useMemo` to sort the jobs array

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/JobsPage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Table headers are clickable for sorting

implementationPlan.description:
Update dashboard/src/pages/JobsPage.tsx:
1. Add sort state: `useState<{ key: string; dir: 'asc' | 'desc' }>({ key: 'updatedAt', dir: 'desc' })`
2. Create a `SortableHeader` component: renders `<th>` with onClick toggling sort direction, shows ChevronUp/ChevronDown icon from lucide-react when active. Inactive headers show subtle up/down indicator on hover.
3. Replace static `<th>` elements for Topic, State, Duration, Updated with `<SortableHeader>`. Keep ID and Safety Decision non-sortable.
4. Add `useMemo` to sort jobs array by sort key: Topic (localeCompare), State (predefined status order map), Duration (numeric, nulls last), Updated (Date.parse). Apply asc/desc direction.
5. Render sorted array instead of raw `jobs`.
implementationPlan.note: All sorting already implemented: SortableHeader component, sortJobs function, handleSort callback, useMemo for sorted jobs, 5 sortable columns (topic, state, pool, duration, updatedAt). No changes needed.
